label: House notes
help: Administrator context in block C; empty preserves the existing prompt.

label: Grow context
help: Optional structured room facts; does not change live substrate, stage, targets or sizing.

label: System cache TTL
help: 5 minutes or 1 hour; evidence remains at 5 minutes.

label: Block A breakpoint
help: Later breakpoints can also cache A because caching covers the cumulative prefix.

label: Block B breakpoint
help: Cache the cumulative prefix through the stage and substrate tables.

label: Block C breakpoint
help: Only present when room notes or structured context are set.

label: Evidence breakpoint
help: Keep the existing 5-minute evidence breakpoint; off removes it from future requests.
